title: Driftwood FSR 7822.01 - 15km Notice (Summer 2026)
source_text: Driftwood FSR 7822.01 - 15km Notice (Summer 2026): Updated June 2026 The Driftwood forest service road will be realignment from 15.1km to 16.7km commencing in Summer 2026. For more information, please read the project information flyer (PDF, 405KB) Upper Driftwood Deactivation Project – 82 to 86 km (Summer 2026) To improve road user safety, the Stuart Nechako District is planning to deactivate a section of the Driftwood FSR that has been bypassed by new road construction. This work is proposed for the summer of 2026. For more information, please read the project information flyer (PDF, 1.1MB)
